The '''LCS 2023 Summer''' was the second split of the 2023 [[League of Legends Championship Series]] season, organized by Riot Games. It took place from June 14 to August 20, 2023, with the Regular Season held at the Riot Games Arena in Los Angeles, United States, and the Finals at the Prudential Center in Newark, United States. Ten franchised teams competed in a Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo1}} Group Stage, followed by a Double Elimination {{Abbr/Bo5}} Playoff bracket. The total prize pool was $200,000 USD.

The top three teams from the Playoffs qualified for the [[World Championship/2023|2023 World Championship]], while the fourth-place team earned a spot in the [[World_Championship/2023/Qualifying_Series|2023 World Qualifying Series]]. [[NRG]] won their first LCS title after defeating [[Cloud9]] 3–1 in the Grand Final. The split was played on patches 13.11 through 13.14, with {{ChampionIcon|Ivern|20px}}, {{ChampionIcon|Rell|20px}}, and {{ChampionIcon|Naafiri|20px}} temporarily disabled.

Following the changes to the [[North American Challengers League]], which saw a lift on the requirement of Challengers teams for [[LCS]] franchises, the ''LCSPA (LCS Player Association)'' announced a walk-out vote. They revealed on May 28th that the vote had received an overwhelming majority.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://twitter.com/NALCSPA/status/1663039093557608448 |title=The walk-out vote has overwhelmingly passed. |author=LCSPA |publisher=Twitter |date=2023-05-28}}</ref> On May 30th, it was announced that the '''LCS''' will be delayed by two weeks, from its original start date of June 1st to June 15th.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://lolesports.com/article/an-update-on-the-2023-lcs-summer-season/blt175d929f90a4804d |title=An Update on the 2023 LCS Summer Season |author=Naz Aletaha |publisher=Riot Games |date=2023-05-30}}</ref>

==Format==
* '''Group Stage''' - 
** Double Round Robin
** Each team plays 18 matches.
**All matches are {{Abbr/Bo1}}
**1st to 8th place will play the Playoffs
***1st and 2nd place are seeded into Upper Bracket Semifinals
***3rd to 6th place are seeded into Upper Bracket Quarterfinals
***7th and 8th place are seeded into Lower Bracket Round 1

* '''Playoffs ''' - 
** Double Elimination
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}} 
** Top 3 qualify for the [[World Championship/2023|2023 World Championship]], 4th place qualifies for the [[World_Championship/2023/Qualifying_Series|2023 World Qualifying Series]].
